scope: Pure diagnostic scores and explicit reference crosswalk; no generator behavior, dialect migration, gate, oldscore or reference modification. Named CMU/rhotic reference is provisional with respect to legacy generator; does not infer a GeneralAmerican realization. Native reference preserves vowel stress digits; coarse reference erases them. AH/ER source mergers remain disclosed; ambiguousɜ is unavailable for strict scoring.

model.boundaries: one # start andend per nonemptyword; no crosswordedges
model.vocabulary: exact pinned observed per-view vocabulary including #; out-of-vocabulary unsupported
model.score: mean negative base2 logprobability per transition, including initial/final boundary transitions
model.notComparableAsImprovement: coarse/native have different target alphabets; no native-minus-coarse qualitygain verdict
model.referenceValidation: entire pinned reference bytes/authentication, integerrow/column conservation, native-to-base paircount identity, immutable detached compilation

stressEvidence.explicit: only actualprimary/secondary syllablemarks; absentmark is unavailable
stressEvidence.trace: separatelyversioned adapter requires actualv1/v2 complete surface-after-realization wordsnapshot with exact wordgeometry/sound/marker alignment; explicitunmarked snapshot supplies unstressed, absent/invalid/mismatched trace does not
stressEvidence.sourceLayer: surface only; no lexical reconstruction from reductionflags

measurement: All600000records only, no newwords/regeneration/validationcohort. Rehash everypinnedrawarchive/source beforeandafter.
Every word gets aligned coarse/native projections with all unsupported identities, slots, missingstress, aliases/mergers/aspiration losses retained.

Full-coarse diagnostics separately reported; matched coarse/native numbers use exactlysame eligiblewords/denominators within each arm. Traceadapter gainsupport separately from explicit-only; no silent fallback or baseline markingguess.
All profiles/seedstreams/actualmorphology/wordlength strata, entire scorestreams/digests and deterministic missing/valid witnesses preserved.
IndependentPython implementation re-enumerates projections/every transition/count/score with fixed1e-12absolute +1e-12relative tolerance; no production scoring/adapter calls.
